extracted.intended_audience: Early career researchers applying to the U.S. DOE Office of Science Early Career Research Program (FY2024), and authorized institutional representatives/research administrators who submit pre-applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting a pre-application and application for the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science Early Career Research Program (Announcement DE-FOA-0003176, Amendment 000001) covering multiple Office of Science program areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-application requirement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-applications due January 30, 2024 at 5:00 pm Eastern Time. Pre-application Response Date is March 14, 2024 at 11:59 pm Eastern Time. Read the FOA (Announcement DE-FOA-0003176, Amendment 000001) for details and required materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized institutional representative submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-Applications must be submitted by an authorized institutional representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the institution's authorized official submits the pre-application (individual applicants should coordinate with their institution's sponsored research/administration office).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable program areas / eligibility scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs: Advanced Scientific Computing Research, Basic Energy Sciences, Biological and Environmental Research, Fusion Energy Sciences, High Energy Physics, Nuclear Physics, Isotope R&D and Production, Accelerator R&D and Production
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This FOA applies to investigators and proposals within the listed Office of Science program areas; consult the full FOA for program-specific eligibility and scope details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key dates and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Close Date: Friday, April 26, 2024. Pre-applications due January 30, 2024 at 5:00 pm Eastern Time. Pre-application Response Date is March 14, 2024 at 11:59 pm Eastern Time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must meet all stated deadlines in the FOA; track both pre-application and full application deadlines and any response dates. Time zones are Eastern Time.

rubrics_metrics.name: FOA amendment / notice updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendment 000001 has been issued to update the Notice on page 11 and to change the Program Manager on page 45.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review Amendment 000001 and the updated FOA pages for any changes to requirements, contacts, or submission instructions; use the latest FOA/amendment when preparing materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant resources and outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Early Career Research Program webinar January 10, 2024 at 1:00 ET; Slides | Video. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for the FY 2024 Early Career Research Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attend or review the webinar, slides, video, and FAQs to clarify application expectations, common questions, and any procedural details; these resources accompany the FOA and may clarify submission and eligibility requirements.
